done_when: The sign-off screens check reviews only the attached screen images and the brief, its refusal states how many findings are open and which of them block sign-off, and source is reviewed only by the strict review.
why: In src/forge/review.py, run() takes the signoff branch with an empty base commit for item design-check, and the omitted-images filter only drops images outside the batch, so all source stays in the tree. Autoreview then splits that whole diff into chunks (review_process.py parallel_parts). Findings from different chunks are merged in design_check() with no de-duplication, so one gap gets reported under several titles. The refusal in src/forge/records.py _signoff_review() lists every open finding with its body under found gaps and does not give a count or say which findings block, while the repair text names only the held ones.
